# OnUnload

[API index](../index)

```typescript
function OnUnload(action: () => void): void;
```

Register best-effort cleanup before script reload, fault teardown, or unload.
Callbacks run in registration order; errors are logged and cleanup commands remain restricted.
Teardown cannot wait: only the synchronous prefix before the first Sleep or pending await runs.

**See also**

RuleBuilderContext.Panic

cleanup, unload, reload, lifecycle
